chunks: Sa'd narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام: "The two rak'ahs of fajr—should I perform them before fajr or after fajr?" He said: "Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: 'Join them onto the night prayer, and perform them before fajr.'"

key_terms.احْشُ بِهِمَا: insert or join them together with
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: the two units of prayer associated with fajr

ai.seo_question: Should the two rak'ahs of fajr be prayed before fajr or after fajr?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the time of performing the two rak'ahs of fajr. It indicates that they are to be attached to the night prayer and performed before fajr, giving a legal ruling on the timing of this devotional act.
